pairing.connectorSecret: per-site 256-bit random secret; SHA-256 stored at Center
pairing.existingSiteUpgrade: existingSiteId accepted for same owner and URL after new pairing code
pairing.proof: one-time user pairing code plus outbound connector key; no independent DNS ownership attestation
pairing.recoveryPolicy: For an existing site, only the original authenticated WordRava OAuth owner plus fresh WP-admin one-time approval may rotate the local connector key. No cross-account site transfer, session reassignment or legacy keyless takeover is automatic; lost original-account identity requires a separate verified recovery process.
pairing.adminRecoveryPolicy: An authorized Center administrator may retire a named site connection after exact-URL confirmation and an audited reason. Old site and history remain archived; connector key revoked; pending jobs cancelled. New pairing requires a fresh 10-minute code, intended OAuth account and WordPress administrator nonce. Each retired site can be replaced at most once.

capabilities.remoteWriteAvailableWhenEnabled: both operations and writes feature flags; WordPress admin opt-in
capabilities.toolReviewPolicy: Named, individually described tools only. Generic future-operation, arbitrary REST and arbitrary ability dispatch are not exposed to models.
capabilities.readOnlyAnnotation: Submitting a read job changes server state and is annotated readOnlyHint=false.

oauth.flow: authorization_code+PKCE S256; public registered client; refresh rotation
oauth.browserCsrf: Same-origin form confirmation with a secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict CSRF cookie; PKCE and exact client/redirect/resource checks preserved.

operation.authorization: center-per-site ownership and OAuth per-operation scope
operation.quota: serializable reservation of pending and successful jobs
operation.writes: Idempotent, scope-checked and locally permitted writes. Sensitive jobs additionally require an exact site-local one-time human decision; Connector >=1.3.0 required.
limitations: No atomic rollback of content edits; use current revisions and a separate site backup.

Native builder preview supports bounded Elementor text, registered controls and flexbox structure changes, Gutenberg text and top-level block operations, and a single local snapshot restore. Divi/Bricks/WPBakery and other builder edits, full responsive/theme/template design, and arbitrary builder operations are not implemented.
SEO adapters cover11 normalized post/page metadata fields; global SEO settings, sitemap configuration and arbitrary schema templates are not exposed.
Operations use outbound WordPress polling; a working WordPress cron or administrative poll is required.
Marketplace review and publisher/domain verification are independent of server deployment.
Arbitrary REST/ability execution and executable ZIP installation/staging are removed from the development target. Use WordPress's native installer. No reviewer exception is assumed.
operation.seoRevision: Both expectedModifiedGmt and exact64-hex expected_seo_revision required for updates; published content also requires publish permission.

builderBeta.read: Paginated node inventory, supported fields and controls, exact revision, local snapshot metadata
builderBeta.patch: Exact unique literal replacement in a supported field
builderBeta.control: Elementor installed control registry and typed allowlist; no arbitrary setting paths
builderBeta.structure: Explicit insert, move, remove; Elementor flex containers and supported installed widgets; Gutenberg supported top-level blocks
builderBeta.restore: Restore exact last protected local snapshot; current document and snapshot revisions required
builderBeta.permissions: Local draft-write opt-in, native edit permissions and explicit approval; published changes require local publication opt-in and native publish permission
builderBeta.verification: Native save, strict persisted tree/readback check; uncertain save requires re-read, never blind retry
builderBeta.unsupported: Fail closed; no generic post-content overwrite of detected native builder pages
builderBeta.status: preview; actual builder and production integration required before enabling

inventory.language: all or an active Polylang language; no silent old-connector fallback
inventory.result: pagination metadata, per-item language and translation IDs; offset inventory is not a snapshot

permissions.legacyPolicy: Preserve old grants; never silently expand them. A new explicit WordPress administrator profile is needed for additional operations.
permissions.newWrites: Read & Write profile, native WordPress capability, OAuth content:write, confirmed exact operation, current revision and stable idempotency key

appearance.css: Active theme native Additional CSS only; refuses preprocessed/oversized CSS and unsafe markup; local bounded snapshot
appearance.headerFooter: Existing native active block-theme header/footer only; database override, no PHP/theme files; bounded snapshot restores text, not original file origin
appearance.unimplemented: Theme-specific options and non-native header builders require dedicated adapters

polylang.unimplemented: Language administration, term translations, translated menus, Pro-specific functionality and unlink/replacement require separate adapters

compatibilityDevelopment.releaseGate: All original and supplemental compatibility targets, required theme features, security, directory compliance and staging acceptance must have verified evidence before 1.3.0 is published.

humanApproval.binding: site, connector key digest, paired administrator, permission revision, job ID, kind, exact payload and deadline

usage.used: Successful completed operations counted once using SiteOperations within current UTC day
usage.reserved: Pending/running jobs reserve capacity immediately (including jobs queued on prior days)
usage.failed: Failed jobs count toward diagnostics but not charged
usage.accountRollup: sum of independent active-site quotas, not shared per-account enforcement
usage.idempotency: successful completion counts once even if connector callbacks are retried
usage.connectorEndpoint: POST /api/v1/connector-usage (site ID and secret authenticated; no browser exposure of connector key)

quickPairing.start: GET+POST /oauth/connect-wordpress (browser account session and CSRF confirmation)
quickPairing.confirm: POST /api/v1/pairing/confirm (WP outbound, exact code+request ID+URL, one-use)
quickPairing.identity: The existing /oauth HttpOnly browser session preserves the OAuth account. Provisional identity activates only after WordPress administrator approval.
quickPairing.accountPlan: Free default; Admin account plan overrides default; explicit per-site plan overrides account plan
quickPairing.limits: No automatic takeover of an already paired site; recovery requires a separately verified account-linking workflow
quickPairing.writes: Disabled until explicit administrator and user approvals
quickPairing.legacyStart: POST /api/v1/pairing/start retained for existing clients; not exposed by public MCP tools
quickPairing.secretHandling: WordPress generates the one-time secret; browser continuation carries it only in URL fragment, clears the fragment before same-origin form submission. Never paste it in chat.
quickPairing.chatgptSetupPrompt: Static public MCP URL, OAuth setup and discovery instructions. Never contains a pairing secret. Plugin Creator availability depends on the account.

releaseComponents.writes: feature-gated; site owner WordPress opt-in, native capabilities and explicit user approval

packageStaging.note: Legacy storage cleanup only; no staging or package-download API is mapped in the development target.
